title: Honzuki no Gekokujou: Ryoushu no Youjo

thread.title: Ascendance of a Bookworm: Adopted Daughter of an Archduke • Honzuki no Gekokujou: Shisho ni Naru Tame ni wa Shudan wo Erandeiraremasen - Ryushu no Youjo - Episode 17 discussion

opinions.point: Many commenters found the talking sword and related character interactions especially funny.
Several enjoyed the grandfather character’s comedic behavior and affection.
Some appreciated the family-focused material and the brief return of familiar supporting characters.
A number of viewers liked the deliberate visual repetition as comedy, while one commenter found the reused shots distracting.
One commenter criticized the episode’s animation as stiff and noticeably budget-conscious.
Some viewers enjoyed the adaptation overall but wished certain material had received more attention.
